citation.verbatim: The tender offer expired at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on June 5, 2024. A total of 119,018,767 shares of Monster's common stock were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share or as purchase price tenders. Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Process final tender results: book gross cash receivable for all 87 validly tendered odd-lot shares accepted in full at $53.00; confirm zero residual MNST shares. Do not submit any new election after expiration. Escalate and hold only the fee/charge deduction question because the referenced Letter of Transmittal is absent from the document store.

probe.derivation: The Offer to Purchase states that stockholders must complete the Letter of Transmittal to tender shares held of record, and the probe asks what fees or charges, if any, will be deducted under the Letter of Transmittal. The Letter of Transmittal for Monster Beverage Corporation tender offer is absent from the document store, so the fee/charge deduction is not determinable from the store; escalated and held only this dependent fee/charge figure.
